title: Quality control
description: Review and average field data before interpretation.

programs.name: CSAVGW
programs.description: Averages raw [CSAMT](/methods/groundmethods/csamt/) data and supports quality control before interpretation.

programs.name: TDAVGW
programs.description: Averages and quality-checks time-domain [IP](/methods/groundmethods/ip/) field data in multiple export formats.

programs.name: TEMAVGW
programs.description: Averages and quality-checks [TEM](/methods/groundmethods/tem/) field data from `.raw`, `.dnt`, `.cac`, and `.zdb` files.

programs.name: CRAVGW
programs.description: Averages and quality-checks complex resistivity field data from Zonge [IP/CR](/methods/groundmethods/ip/) systems.

programs.name: HEMAVGW
programs.description: Averages and quality-checks EM field data.

programs.name: MTEDIT
programs.description: Reviews [MT](/methods/groundmethods/mt/) spectral data and calculates averaged impedance and apparent resistivity with interactive QC editing.

title: Processing
description: Convert MT time series into spectral coefficients for impedance analysis.

programs.name: MTFT
programs.description: Processes [MT](/methods/groundmethods/mt/) time-series data into spectral coefficients for downstream impedance analysis.

title: Modeling & inversion
description: Build resistivity models and sections from survey data.

programs.name: SCS2D
programs.description: Performs 2D inversion of [CSAMT](/methods/groundmethods/csamt/), AMT, and [MT](/methods/groundmethods/mt/) data to create resistivity-depth sections.

programs.name: TS2DIP
programs.description: Performs 2D inversion and modeling of [IP](/methods/groundmethods/ip/) and resistivity data for section-based interpretation.

programs.name: SCSINV
programs.description: Runs smooth-model 1D [CSAMT](/methods/groundmethods/csamt/) inversion to build stitched resistivity-depth images along a line.

programs.name: STEMINV
programs.description: Performs smooth-model 1D inversion of [TEM](/methods/groundmethods/tem/) soundings into layered-earth resistivity models.

title: Correction & export
description: Apply MT static correction and prepare outputs for other workflows.

programs.name: ASTATIC
programs.description: Applies [MT](/methods/groundmethods/mt/) static correction and converts survey outputs into formats such as SEG and EDI.
